name: Crittenden County, AR
findings: Crittenden County has 121 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Crittenden County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Crittenden County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 65% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
